scope: Read-only exact Keystone 1048P polarity diagnosis; no source or PCB correction applied

primary.authorship: Keystone Electronics Corp., exact drawing 1048P, Rev A 10.08.13; manufacturer-authored sheet hosted by a distributor
primary.section: Full one-page sheet, component TOP view with moulded positive/negative marks and mounting-pad layout; independently visually checked by two reviewers
primary.view: Component top, long axis horizontal, +X right, +Y down; upper row positive at left/negative at right, lower row negative at left/positive at right
primary.revision_limit: Rev B has not been visually verified; do not relabel Rev A as Rev B or assume unseen mounting dimensions.

diagnosis: The custom library places logical positive contacts 1 and 3 at the same longitudinal end. The exact polarized 1048P has opposite cell orientation. Rotating the whole holder cannot repair both rows simultaneously. Correct current-R2 pad positions while retaining logical roles, then verify the complete affected power paths and all copper attachments. The polarity contradiction is independent of unresolved locator/mounting-hole registration.
not_claimed: Clean library parity or DRC does not override this physical polarity finding
